name: Vandenberg SFB
description: Vandenberg SFB is the West Coast launch site for national security space missions and home of Space Launch Delta 30. It supports polar orbit launches and missile testing.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Santa Maria Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. Visitor Center at 6 California Blvd outside gate Mon-Fri 0600-1800.
gates.address: Santa Maria Gate, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

gates.name: Visitor Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed Sat-Sun and federal holidays
gates.notes: Phone: 805-606-7663. Does not sell merchandise or provide launch schedules.

gates.name: Lompoc Gate (Commercial)
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle inspections mornings; all traffic afternoons.

resources.name: Breakers Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting space launch operations with full meal service, N’Rich Grill, Global Grill, deli, pizza, salad bar, and wireless access.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0630-0930, Grab-n-Go 0930-1100, Lunch 1100-1400, Grab-n-Go 1400-1700, Dinner 1700-1900; Sat-Sun/Holidays: Brunch 0730-1330, Grab-n-Go 1330-1700, Dinner 1700-1900
resources.address: Bldg 13330, Oregon Ave, Vandenberg SFB, CA 93437

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Pacific Coast Inn for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (805-605-2048) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 30 FSS, M&FRC, and official Vandenberg sites for in-processing and space launch support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
